botswana.title: Flag of the Republic of Botswana

colors.note: Represents water, in particular the rain-bearing skies and the national motto Pula ('rain').
Together with black, symbolises racial harmony and the zebra, the national animal.
Symbolises racial harmony alongside white; drawn from the zebra's stripes.

desc:
- A light blue field with a central horizontal black stripe edged in white
- The design deliberately contrasts with apartheid-era South Africa's red, white and blue
- Adopted on 30 September 1966 when the Bechuanaland Protectorate gained independence
trivia:
- The national motto 'Pula' means rain in Setswana, which is scarce and precious in the Kalahari
- Black and white evoke the zebra, Botswana's national animal
- One of the few African flags not using Pan-African red, yellow, green, or black
